bills.title: National Disability Insurance Scheme Amendment (Getting the NDIS Back on Track No. 1) Bill 2024

name: The majority voted in favour of a [motion](https://www.openaustralia.org.au/senate/?id=2024-06-27.151.2) introduced by South Australian Senator [Anne Ruston](https://theyvoteforyou.org.au/people/senate/sa/anne_ruston), which means it passed and a [new inquiry](https://www.aph.gov.au/Parliamentary_Business/Committees/Senate/Community_Affairs/NDISAmendment24) will be created. > *That the [National Disability Insurance Scheme Amendment (Getting the NDIS Back on Track No. 1) Bill 2024](https://parlinfo.aph.gov.au/parlInfo/search/display/display.w3p;query=Id:legislation/billhome/r7181) be referred to the [Community Affairs Legislation Committee](https://www.aph.gov.au/Parliamentary_Business/Committees/Senate/Community_Affairs) for further inquiry, including examining any circulated amendments to the bill and the positions of state and territory governments, and report by 5 August 2024.*
question: The majority voted in favour of a [motion](https://www.openaustralia.org.au/senate/?id=2024-06-27.151.2) introduced by South Australian Senator [Anne Ruston](https://theyvoteforyou.org.au/people/senate/sa/anne_ruston), which means it passed and a [new inquiry](https://www.aph.gov.au/Parliamentary_Business/Committees/Senate/Community_Affairs/NDISAmendment24) will be created. > *That the [National Disability Insurance Scheme Amendment (Getting the NDIS Back on Track No. 1) Bill 2024](https://parlinfo.aph.gov.au/parlInfo/search/display/display.w3p;query=Id:legislation/billhome/r7181) be referred to the [Community Affairs Legislation Committee](https://www.aph.gov.au/Parliamentary_Business/Committees/Senate/Community_Affairs) for further inquiry, including examining any circulated amendments to the bill and the positions of state and territory governments, and report by 5 August 2024.*
